_comment: LIVING reference config, NOT a final product. Edit n, x, seeds, weights, thresholds, extra_metrics at ANY time EXCEPT mid-round (finish running round on old settings, log change+reason in owning l-2 task Result:, rerun affected tournaments from R1 if weights changed). Code reads this file; humans tune it.

evolve.saturation_rule: a full round with no improvement on the composite score = saturated: log reason, stop. Stop-goal unmet after x rounds = keep evolving past x, reason logged.
evolve.note: n = variants tested per round. R1 = n fresh variants. R2 = n children of winner. R3..x = n children of 2nd-winner variants. One ALG per evolve task, always.

metrics._comment: All weights should sum to 1.0 per ALG after overrides. higher_is_better=false means lower raw value scores higher.

speed.desc: wall-clock ms + scaling note per grid size

complexity.desc: lines of code + allocations; simpler wins ties

energy.desc: allocations x steps proxy for resource/energy cost

reproducibility.desc: seed-variance gate: high variance fails regardless of mean

per_alg_overrides._comment: Per-ALG weight/threshold tweaks. Missing ALGs use global metrics as-is.

ALG-WELL.stop_goal: C6 max-err < 1e-10 on 12-point + fuzz set AND fastest of the accurate variants

ALG-ENC.stop_goal: round-trip SNR > 60dB on sine+chirp+noise AND leakage below Hann baseline

ALG-LAP.stop_goal: plane-wave eigen L2 err < 1e-4 AND drift bounded over 1000 steps

ALG-STEP.stop_goal: max stable dt recorded AND drift < 1e-6 per 1000 steps at chosen dt

ALG-FREE.stop_goal: analytic match 1e-6 AND gradient FD-check 1e-6 AND F strictly monotonic on double-well fixture

ALG-EXT.stop_goal: 100% mode accuracy on synthetic modes AND >= 95% at noise sigma 0.05

ALG-PROTO.stop_goal: ONE winner by composite score across 3 seeds; sim-only, no hardware claims

ALG-SOV.stop_goal: matches reference sim 1e-6 AND linear grid scaling

ALG-OPT.stop_goal: fewest steps to |dF| < 1e-4 on double-well Omega across 3 seeds

ALG-NLIN.stop_goal: no blow-up for g in [0.1, 10] AND XOR-wave fixture separable
